purpose: Offer street/satellite/none at every app zoom while preserving Leaflet camera, selected dataset/scope, geometry and analytical colours.

defaultSatellite.sourceType: Existing CityChat public hybrid XYZ tile URL
defaultSatellite.nativeCapMeaning: Client request cap inherited from existing repo 3D source configuration; this does not certify availability or source resolution for every location.
defaultSatellite.reuseAuthorization: User explicitly requested reuse of the satellite source currently used by CityChat. This authorizes source-compatible implementation; it does not establish new third-party entitlements.

officialSupportedMigration.difference: Official Google Maps Tile API uses API-key/session requests, viewport availability and attribution metadata. The current legacy mt1 URL is not asserted equivalent to that API or licence.
officialSupportedMigration.status: Existing rights/account/session configuration remains to be confirmed; no key was extracted or added.

providerEligibility.basis: User-authorized reuse of exact existing CityChat source

providerEligibility.rightsEvidence: Specific EOX2016 per-layer CC BY4.0 declaration; existing cached Sila-only original tiles retained.

providerEligibility.reason: Newer products are declared CC BY-NC-SA4.0; no commercial licence evidence supplied.
Public/tokenless endpoint is not proof of commercial use rights. Current Esri item terms point to ArcGIS/Esri licensing; existing licensed provider confirmation is pending.

hostIntegration.themeHandler: S.tile?.setTheme(S.theme); satellite pixels/layer remain intact across theme changes. Host may rebuild its analytical UI separately without a camera fit.
hostIntegration.caption: Set #basemap-caption.textContent = layer.getBasemapState().zoomNotice on basemapstatus and basemapzoom; show when mode==='satellite' or mode==='satellite-archive'.
hostIntegration.cleanup: S.map.removeLayer(layer); layer.off(); clears child tile/GL layer, startup timeout and map zoomend listener.
hostIntegration.customLicensedProvider: Additional provider objects still require licenseConfirmed:true; built-in googleCitychat explicitly preserves requested existing-source compatibility and records licence not verified.
hostIntegration.staticServerAndPublishAllow: vendor/satellite-eox-2016/**/*.jpg and the reference JSON/MD files; serve JPEG as image/jpeg.

stateRules.cameraAuthority: Only host Leaflet controls/drill/focus may write camera. Neither basemap.js nor official bridge writes Leaflet setView/setZoom/fitBounds/pan/fly; bridge only reads Leaflet state and calls MapLibre jumpTo.
stateRules.paletteAuthority: Satellite image colours are source pixels. No filter/opacity transformation is applied to analytical layers; basemap stays in tilePane below all data and municipal outsideMask.
stateRules.allZoomMeaning: Satellite source remains available as a selectable basemap at app zoom8–20: Google requests capped19 and overzoomed19→20; archive uses cached8–14 and overzooms14→20. Rendering at a zoom does not establish native imagery detail or current capture date.
stateRules.fallback: No silent imagery-provider switch. Google failure remains Google unavailable/degraded; user may explicitly choose the labelled historical EOX option. Street failure retains explicit OSM fallback.
stateRules.countSemantics: Changing basemap or zoom changes no analytical scope, source geometry, coordinates or record counts.

verification.moduleAssertionsScope: Exact repo-source URL/CORS and truthful metadata; native19→20 overzoom; mode/theme/camera lifecycle; explicit EOX archive; no silent imagery-provider fallback. Headless mocks, not native browser tile availability.

assetChecks.nativeZoomCap14Reason: Display uses original 10m Sentinel-2 product at z14; cached imagery is overzoomed at app zoom >14. Generic WMTS matrix levels up to21 do not prove additional native image detail.

verification.sourceTileVisualReview: Center z14 source tile viewed: nonblank satellite imagery; no claim about current field accuracy.
verification.cameraDriftReview: Complete official bridge inspected; no reverse GL-to-Leaflet camera setter. No new unsolicited fit fix added without a reproducible source.
verification.browserRenderAndDeployment: Root-owned QA pending for current source-compatible revision.
verification.googleImageDownload: None; only root browser QA may load tiles at requested views.
